    --accent:#35D6B8;
    --accent-soft:rgba(53,214,184,0.16);

    --map-bg:#060B12;
    --map-grid-strong:rgba(94,234,212,0.24);
    --map-label:rgba(197,225,219,0.55);

    --radius:12px;
    --font-sans:"IBM Plex Sans", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
    --font-mono:"IBM Plex Mono", "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, monospace;
  }

  *{ box-sizing:border-box; }
  body{
    margin:0;
    background:var(--bg);
    color:var(--ink);
    font-family:var(--font-sans);
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  }
  ::selection{ background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--ink); }
  a{ color:var(--accent); text-decoration-color:rgba(53,214,184,0.4); }
  a:hover{ text-decoration-color:currentColor; }

  .page{
    max-width:1560px;
    margin:0 auto;
    padding:2.75rem 2rem 4.5rem;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    gap:1.75rem;
  }

  .subtitle{
    margin:0;
    max-width:68ch;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    font-size:1.05rem;
    line-height:1.55;
  }

  .tabs{
    margin-top:0.5rem;
    display:flex;
    gap:0.25rem;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .tab-btn{
    font-family:var(--font-sans);
    font-size:0.92rem;
    font-weight:500;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    background:none;
    border:none;
    border-bottom:2px solid transparent;
    padding:0.7rem 0.9rem 0.6rem;
    margin-bottom:-1px;
    cursor:pointer;
  }
  .tab-btn:hover{ color:var(--ink); }
  .tab-btn.active{ color:var(--ink); border-bottom-color:var(--accent); }

  .count{
    font-family:var(--font-mono);
    font-size:0.82rem;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
  }
  .count b{ color:var(--ink); font-weight:600; }

  /* ---- Provider dashboard ---- */
  .provider-dashboard{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit, minmax(230px, 1fr));
    gap:1rem;
    margin-top:1.75rem;
  }
  .provider-card{
    position:relative;
    background:var(--surface);
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius:var(--radius);
    padding:1.1rem 1.2rem 1rem;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    gap:0.75rem;
    transition:opacity 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease;
  }
  .provider-card.inactive{ opacity:0.42; }
  .provider-card:hover{ border-color:var(--dot); }
  .provider-card.active{ border-color:var(--dot); }
  .provider-card.collapsed{ padding-bottom:1.1rem; gap:0; }
  .provider-card.collapsed .provider-card-stats,
  .provider-card.collapsed .provider-newsfeed{
    display:none;
  }
  .provider-card-head{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:0.55rem;
    padding-right:2.2rem;
  }
  .provider-card-dot{
    width:10px; height:10px; border-radius:50%;
    background:var(--dot);
    box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--dot) 25%, transparent);
    flex-shrink:0;
  }
  .provider-card-name{
    font-weight:650;
    font-size:1rem;
    letter-spacing:-0.005em;
  }
  .provider-card-stats{
    display:flex;
    gap:1.5rem;
  }
  .provider-stat-value{
    font-family:var(--font-mono);
    font-size:1.2rem;
    font-weight:600;
    font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
    line-height:1.1;
  }
  .provider-stat-label{
    font-family:var(--font-mono);
    font-size:0.66rem;
    letter-spacing:0.07em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    margin-top:0.2rem;
  }
  .provider-site-item{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:0.5rem;
    padding:0.35rem 0.15rem;
    font-size:0.8rem;
    cursor:pointer;
    border-radius:4px;
  }
  .provider-site-item:hover{ background:var(--surface-2); }
  .provider-site-name{
    flex:1;
    min-width:0;
    overflow:hidden;
    text-overflow:ellipsis;
    white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .provider-site-loc{
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    font-size:0.72rem;
    flex-shrink:0;
  }
  .provider-site-cap{
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    font-family:var(--font-mono);
    font-size:0.72rem;
    font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
    flex-shrink:0;
    width:4.6em;
    text-align:right;
  }
  .status-dot{ width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; flex-shrink:0; }
  .status-dot.status-operational{ background:#4ADE80; }
  .status-dot.status-under-construction{ background:#FBBF24; }
  .status-dot.status-planned{ background:#94A3B8; }

  .provider-newsfeed{
    border-top:1px dashed var(--border);
    padding-top:0.65rem;
    font-size:0.8rem;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    line-height:1.5;
    font-style:italic;
  }
  .provider-toggle{
    position:absolute;
    top:0.95rem;
    right:0.95rem;
    width:32px;
    height:19px;
    border-radius:999px;
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    background:var(--surface-2);
    cursor:pointer;
    padding:0;
    transition:border-color 0.15s ease;
  }
  .provider-toggle::after{
    content:"";
    display:block;
    width:13px; height:13px;
    margin:2px;
    border-radius:50%;
    background:var(--ink-soft);
    transition:transform 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease;
  }
  .provider-toggle[aria-pressed="true"]{ border-color:var(--dot); }
  .provider-toggle[aria-pressed="true"]::after{
    transform:translateX(13px);
    background:var(--dot);
  }

  .table-toolbar{
    display:flex;
    justify-content:flex-end;
    padding:0.7rem 1rem 0;
  }

  /* ---- Provider page (opened by clicking a dashboard card) ---- */
  .provider-card{ cursor:pointer; }
  .back-link{
    background:none;
    border:none;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    font-family:var(--font-mono);
    font-size:0.82rem;
    letter-spacing:0.02em;
    cursor:pointer;
    padding:0.3rem 0;
  }
  .back-link:hover{ color:var(--accent); }
  .provider-page-head{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:0.75rem;
    margin-top:0.5rem;
  }
  .provider-page-dot{
    width:14px; height:14px; border-radius:50%;
    background:var(--dot);
    box-shadow:0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--dot) 25%, transparent);
    flex-shrink:0;
  }
  .provider-page-head h1{
    margin:0;
    font-size:1.7rem;
    font-weight:650;
    letter-spacing:-0.01em;
  }
  .provider-page-stats{
    display:flex;
    gap:2.25rem;
    flex-wrap:wrap;
    padding:1.1rem 0 0.25rem;
  }
  .provider-page-stat-value{
    font-family:var(--font-mono);
    font-size:1.55rem;
    font-weight:600;
    font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
    line-height:1.1;
  }
  .provider-page-stat-label{
    font-family:var(--font-mono);
    font-size:0.68rem;
    letter-spacing:0.06em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    margin-top:0.25rem;
  }
  .provider-page-col-left{
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    gap:1.5rem;
  }
  .provider-page-partners{
    background:var(--surface);
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius:var(--radius);
    padding:1.1rem 1.2rem;
  }
  .provider-page-partners h2{
    margin:0 0 0.75rem;
    font-size:0.95rem;
    font-weight:600;
  }
  .provider-page-partners ul{
    list-style:none;
    margin:0;
    padding:0;
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill, minmax(260px, 1fr));
    gap:0.75rem;
  }
  .partner-card{
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius:8px;
    padding:0.7rem 0.85rem;
  }
  .partner-top{
    display:flex;
    align-items:baseline;
    justify-content:space-between;
    gap:0.5rem;
  }
  .partner-name{ font-weight:600; font-size:0.9rem; }
  .partner-relationship{
    font-family:var(--font-mono);
    font-size:0.66rem;
    letter-spacing:0.04em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--accent);
    white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .partner-detail{
    margin:0.35rem 0 0;
    font-size:0.8rem;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    line-height:1.45;
  }
  .partner-meta{
    display:block;
    margin-top:0.4rem;
    font-family:var(--font-mono);
    font-size:0.68rem;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
  }
  .partner-meta a{ color:var(--ink-soft); }
  .partner-meta a:hover{ color:var(--accent); }
  .partners-empty{
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    font-size:0.85rem;
    font-style:italic;
  }

  .provider-page-body{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);
    gap:1.5rem;
    margin-top:1.5rem;
  }
  @media (max-width:860px){ .provider-page-body{ grid-template-columns:1fr; } }
  .provider-page-body section{
    background:var(--surface);
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius:var(--radius);
    padding:1.1rem 1.2rem;
  }
  .provider-page-body h2{
    margin:0 0 0.75rem;
    font-size:0.95rem;
    font-weight:600;
  }
  .provider-page-locations ul{
    list-style:none;
    margin:0;
    padding:0;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    max-height:420px;
    overflow-y:auto;
  }
  .headline-list{
    list-style:none;
    margin:0;
    padding:0;
  }
  .headline-item{
    padding:0.65rem 0;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
    font-size:0.85rem;
    line-height:1.4;
  }
  .headline-item:last-child{ border-bottom:none; }
  .headline-item a{ color:var(--ink); font-weight:500; }
  .headline-item a:hover{ color:var(--accent); }
  .headline-top{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:0.5rem;
    margin-bottom:0.2rem;
  }
  .headline-date{
    font-family:var(--font-mono);
    font-size:0.68rem;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .headline-category{
    font-family:var(--font-mono);
    font-size:0.62rem;
    letter-spacing:0.05em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    padding:0.1rem 0.4rem;
    border-radius:999px;
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    color:var(--ink-soft);
  }
  .headline-title{ display:block; }
  .headline-why{
    margin:0.25rem 0 0;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    font-size:0.8rem;
    line-height:1.45;
  }
  .headline-meta{
    display:block;
    margin-top:0.3rem;
    font-family:var(--font-mono);
    font-size:0.7rem;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
  }
  .headline-meta a{ color:var(--ink-soft); font-weight:400; }
  .headline-meta a:hover{ color:var(--accent); }
  .headline-empty{
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    font-size:0.85rem;
    font-style:italic;
  }
  .provider-page-search-link{
    display:inline-block;
    margin-top:0.9rem;
    font-family:var(--font-mono);
    font-size:0.78rem;
  }

  .map-panel{
    background:var(--map-bg);
    border-radius:var(--radius);
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    overflow:hidden;
    position:relative;
    min-height:760px;
    transition:min-height 0.3s ease;
  }
  /* ~40% shorter while a provider panel is expanded, so the site table's
     replacement (the provider panel) doesn't push the map far down the
     page. */
  .map-panel.compact{ min-height:456px; }
  #map{ position:absolute; inset:0; }
  .maplibregl-ctrl-attrib{ font-size:10px !important; }
  .map-loading{
    position:absolute; inset:0;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    font-family:var(--font-mono);
    font-size:0.8rem;
    letter-spacing:0.06em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--map-label);
  }
  .reset-view{
    position:absolute;
    right:14px; top:14px;
    font-family:var(--font-mono);
    font-size:0.72rem;
    letter-spacing:0.04em;
    color:var(--map-label);
    background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
    border:1px solid var(--map-grid-strong);
    border-radius:6px;
    padding:0.3rem 0.6rem;
    cursor:pointer;
  }
  .reset-view:hover{ color:#5EEAD4; border-color:#5EEAD4; }

  .map-caption{
    position:absolute;
    left:16px; bottom:14px;
    font-family:var(--font-mono);
    font-size:0.72rem;
    letter-spacing:0.06em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--map-label);
    pointer-events:none;
  }
  .map-caption span{ color:#5EEAD4; }

  /* Pins are plain DOM elements handed to MapLibre as marker content — the
     library positions/repositions them on pan/zoom itself (off the main
     thread's rendering path), so unlike the old SVG version there's no
     per-frame JS needed to keep them placed or constant-sized. */
  .pin-marker{
    width:30px; height:30px;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    /* No position here: MapLibre's own .maplibregl-marker rule sets
       position:absolute, which it needs for its placement transform to be
       relative to the map, not this element's normal-flow position. Setting
       position:relative here (same specificity, later in the cascade) used
       to silently win and break marker placement. absolute still works fine
       as the positioning context .pin-halo/.pin-pulse/.pin-ring need. */
    cursor:pointer;
  }
  .pin-marker.dim{ display:none; }
  .pin-core{
    width:10px; height:10px;
    border-radius:50%;
    background:var(--dot);
    border:1.4px solid #060B12;
    transition:transform 0.15s ease;
  }
  .pin-marker:hover .pin-core, .pin-marker:focus .pin-core, .pin-marker.active .pin-core{ transform:scale(1.4); }
  .pin-halo{
    position:absolute;
    width:26px; height:26px;
    border-radius:50%;
    background:var(--dot);
    opacity:0;
    transition:opacity 0.15s ease;
  }
  .pin-marker:hover .pin-halo, .pin-marker:focus .pin-halo, .pin-marker.active .pin-halo{ opacity:0.35; }
  .pin-marker:hover, .pin-marker:focus{ z-index:10; }

  .pin-label{
    position:absolute;
    bottom:calc(100% + 6px);
    left:50%;
    transform:translateX(-50%);
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
    gap:0.1rem;
    padding:0.35rem 0.55rem;
    border-radius:6px;
    background:var(--surface);
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    white-space:nowrap;
    opacity:0;
    pointer-events:none;
    transition:opacity 0.12s ease;
  }
  .pin-marker:hover .pin-label, .pin-marker:focus .pin-label{ opacity:1; }
  .pin-label-name{
    font-size:0.76rem;
    font-weight:600;
    color:var(--ink);
    line-height:1.2;
  }
  .pin-label-cap{
    font-family:var(--font-mono);
    font-size:0.68rem;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    line-height:1.2;
  }

  /* Operational sites pulse to read as "live"; planned/under-construction sites
     stay static and muted, with a dashed ring standing in for "not built yet".
     Animates transform:scale() (GPU-composited) rather than width/height, so
     it doesn't force a layout recalculation every frame. */
  .pin-marker.pin-status-operational .pin-core{ opacity:1; }
  .pin-pulse{
    position:absolute;
    width:10px; height:10px;
    border-radius:50%;
    border:2px solid var(--dot);
    opacity:0;
  }
  .pin-marker.pin-status-operational .pin-pulse{ animation:pin-pulse 2.4s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.6,0.4,1) infinite; }
  @keyframes pin-pulse{
    0%   { transform:scale(1); border-width:3px; opacity:0.6; }
    100% { transform:scale(3); border-width:0.5px; opacity:0; }
  }
  .pin-marker.pin-status-under-construction .pin-core{ opacity:0.6; }
  .pin-ring{
    position:absolute;
    width:18px; height:18px;
    border-radius:50%;
    border:1.2px dashed var(--dot);
    opacity:0.7;
  }
  .pin-marker.pin-status-planned .pin-core{ opacity:0.4; width:8px; height:8px; }
  .pin-marker.pin-status-planned .pin-ring{ border-style:dotted; opacity:0.55; }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
    .pin-marker.pin-status-operational .pin-pulse{ animation:none; display:none; }
  }

  /* Floating overlay inside .map-panel (its positioning context), anchored
     toward the bottom-right instead of taking a fixed column — hidden until
     a site is selected so the map gets the full page width by default. */
  .detail-panel{
    position:absolute;
    right:16px;
    top:50%;
    width:380px;
    max-width:calc(100% - 32px);
    max-height:calc(100% - 32px);
    overflow-y:auto;
    background:var(--surface);
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius:var(--radius);
    padding:1.3rem 1.4rem;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    gap:1rem;
    box-shadow:0 12px 34px rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
    z-index:6;
    opacity:0;
    /* Two translateY()s compose: -50% centers the panel on the map's
       vertical midpoint (relative to its own height), the fixed 10px is
       just the open/close slide-in offset on top of that center point. */
    transform:translateY(-50%) translateY(10px);
    pointer-events:none;
    transition:opacity 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease;
  }
  .detail-panel.open{
    opacity:1;
    transform:translateY(-50%);
    pointer-events:auto;
  }
  .detail-close{
    position:absolute;
    top:0.7rem;
    right:0.7rem;
    width:24px;
    height:24px;
    border-radius:6px;
    border:1px solid transparent;
    background:none;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    font-size:1.1rem;
    line-height:1;
    cursor:pointer;
  }
  .detail-close:hover{ color:var(--ink); border-color:var(--border); }
  .detail-empty{
    margin:auto;
    text-align:center;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    font-size:0.92rem;
    max-width:26ch;
    line-height:1.55;
  }
  .detail-head{
    display:flex;
    align-items:flex-start;
    justify-content:space-between;
    gap:0.5rem;
  }
  .detail-head h2{
    margin:0;
    font-size:1.3rem;
    font-weight:650;
    letter-spacing:-0.005em;
  }
  .provider-tag{
    font-family:var(--font-mono);
    font-size:0.7rem;
    letter-spacing:0.06em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    padding:0.25rem 0.55rem;
    border-radius:5px;
    color:#0A0F0E;
    white-space:nowrap;
    font-weight:600;
  }
  .region-code{
    font-family:var(--font-mono);
    font-size:0.85rem;
    color:var(--accent);
  }
  .kv{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;
    gap:0.45rem 0.9rem;
    font-size:0.9rem;
  }
  .kv dt{ color:var(--ink-soft); }
  .kv dd{ margin:0; font-family:var(--font-mono); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }

  .status-pill{
    display:inline-flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:0.4rem;
    font-family:var(--font-mono);
    font-size:0.78rem;
    letter-spacing:0.02em;
    padding:0.15rem 0.6rem 0.15rem 0.5rem;
    border-radius:999px;
  }
  .status-pill::before{ content:""; width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:currentColor; flex-shrink:0; }
  .status-operational{ background:rgba(74,222,128,0.14); color:#4ADE80; }
  .status-under-construction{ background:rgba(251,191,36,0.14); color:#FBBF24; }
  .status-planned{ background:rgba(148,163,184,0.14); color:#94A3B8; }
  .status-all{ background:var(--surface-2); color:var(--ink-soft); }

  .status-th{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:space-between;
    gap:0.6rem;
  }
  .status-toggle{
    font-family:var(--font-mono);
    text-transform:none;
    letter-spacing:0.02em;
    border:1px solid transparent;
    cursor:pointer;
    transition:border-color 0.12s ease;
  }
  .status-toggle:hover{ border-color:currentColor; }

  .source-line{
    font-size:0.78rem;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    margin:0;
  }
  .source-line a{ color:var(--accent); }

  .notes-box{
    border:1px dashed var(--border);
    border-radius:8px;
    padding:0.75rem 0.85rem;
    font-size:0.88rem;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    font-style:italic;
    line-height:1.5;
  }

  section.table-section{
    background:var(--surface);
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius:var(--radius);
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  /* ~25 rows visible before scrolling — row height (~43.6px, from tbody
     td's padding + line-height) times 25 plus the header's own height. */
  .table-scroll{ overflow-x:auto; overflow-y:auto; max-height:1120px; }
  table{
    width:100%;
    border-collapse:collapse;
    font-size:0.9rem;
    min-width:640px;
  }
  thead th{
    text-align:left;
    font-family:var(--font-mono);
    font-weight:500;
    font-size:0.72rem;
    letter-spacing:0.08em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    padding:0.8rem 1rem;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
    background:var(--surface-2);
    position:sticky;
    top:0;
    z-index:1;
  }
  tbody td{
    padding:0.7rem 1rem;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
    vertical-align:middle;
  }
  tbody tr{ cursor:pointer; transition:background 0.12s ease; }
  tbody tr:hover{ background:var(--surface-2); }
  tbody tr.active{ background:var(--accent-soft); }
  tbody tr:last-child td{ border-bottom:none; }
  td.mono, th.mono{ font-family:var(--font-mono); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
  .provider-dot{
    display:inline-block; width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%;
    margin-right:0.5rem; vertical-align:middle;
  }

  footer.foot{
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    font-size:0.8rem;
    text-align:center;
    padding-top:0.5rem;
  }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
    *{ transition:none !important; }
  }
</style>

<script>
(function(){

  // SITES comes from data/sites.js, PROVIDERS from data/providers.js —
  // both loaded before this script.

  // ---- Provider colors ---------------------------------------------------
  // A provider entry in data/providers.js can pin a specific color; any
  // provider name that shows up in SITES without one there gets the next
  // unused color from PALETTE automatically, no edit needed.
  var PALETTE = ["#E39149", "#5B9BE0", "#9A85E0", "#E0708A", "#D9C24E", "#4FC2C9", "#C97AD1"];
  var providerLookup = {};
  (typeof PROVIDERS !== "undefined" ? PROVIDERS : []).forEach(function(p){ providerLookup[p.name] = p; });
  var providerColor = {};
  (function assignColors(){
    var seen = [];
    SITES.forEach(function(s){ if (seen.indexOf(s.provider) === -1) seen.push(s.provider); });
    var next = 0;
    seen.forEach(function(p){
      var pinned = providerLookup[p] && providerLookup[p].color;
      providerColor[p] = pinned || PALETTE[next++ % PALETTE.length];
    });
  })();
  function colorFor(provider){ return providerColor[provider] || "#5EEAD4"; }
  function statusSlug(status){ return (status||"").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]+/g,"-").replace(/(^-|-$)/g,""); }

  // Table row order: grouped by provider (first-appearance order, same as
  // the color assignment above), then within each provider by status —
  // Operational, then Under construction, then Planned.
  var providerOrder = Object.keys(providerColor);
  var STATUS_ORDER = { "Operational": 0, "Under construction": 1, "Planned": 2 };
  function tableSortCompare(a, b){
    var pd = providerOrder.indexOf(a.provider) - providerOrder.indexOf(b.provider);
    if (pd !== 0) return pd;
    var sa = STATUS_ORDER[a.status] != null ? STATUS_ORDER[a.status] : 99;
    var sb = STATUS_ORDER[b.status] != null ? STATUS_ORDER[b.status] : 99;
    return sa - sb;
  }
  // ---- Map (MapLibre GL, CARTO Dark Matter vector basemap) --------------
  // Markers are plain DOM elements MapLibre positions/repositions itself on
  // pan/zoom — no custom projection math or per-frame transform code needed
  // (that was the source of the old SVG map's sluggishness under load).
  var pinEls = {};
  var DEFAULT_SITE_ZOOM = 9;

  var lons = SITES.map(function(s){ return s.lon; });
  var lats = SITES.map(function(s){ return s.lat; });
  var fitBoundsArg = [
    [Math.min.apply(null, lons), Math.min.apply(null, lats)],
    [Math.max.apply(null, lons), Math.max.apply(null, lats)]
  ];

  // Default landing view is North America, not a fit-to-all-sites bound —
  // "Reset view" still fits every site (fitBoundsArg below), a distinct,
  // still-useful "show me everything" action.
  var DEFAULT_CENTER = [-98, 39];
  var DEFAULT_ZOOM = 3;

  var map = new maplibregl.Map({
    container: "map",
    style: "https://basemaps.cartocdn.com/gl/dark-matter-gl-style/style.json",
    center: DEFAULT_CENTER,
    zoom: DEFAULT_ZOOM,
    minZoom: 0.8,
    maxZoom: 14,
    dragRotate: false,
    pitchWithRotate: false,
    touchPitch: false
  });
  map.touchZoomRotate.disableRotation();
  // Globe instead of flat Mercator: vector tiles are Mercator-projected at
  // the data level regardless, but rendering them onto a sphere removes the
  // flat projection's area/distance distortion (no more oversized Nordic
  // countries) since a globe has no projection to distort in the first
  // place — it's a straightforward map onto the actual 3D shape.
  map.on("style.load", function(){ map.setProjection({ type: "globe" }); });

  function buildPins(){
    SITES.forEach(function(site){
      var slug = statusSlug(site.status);
      var el = document.createElement("div");
      el.className = "pin-marker pin-status-" + slug;
      el.style.setProperty("--dot", colorFor(site.provider));
      el.title = site.provider + (site.site ? " · " + site.site : "") + " (" + site.city + ") — " + site.status;
      el.tabIndex = 0;

      if (slug !== "operational") {
        var ring = document.createElement("span");
        ring.className = "pin-ring";
        el.appendChild(ring);
      }
      if (slug === "operational") {
        var pulse = document.createElement("span");
        pulse.className = "pin-pulse";
        el.appendChild(pulse);
      }
      var halo = document.createElement("span");
      halo.className = "pin-halo";
      var core = document.createElement("span");
      core.className = "pin-core";
      el.appendChild(halo);
      el.appendChild(core);

      var label = document.createElement("span");
      label.className = "pin-label";
      label.innerHTML =
        '<span class="pin-label-name">' + site.provider + ' - ' + site.city + '</span>' +
        '<span class="pin-label-cap">' + (site.capacityMW != null ? site.capacityMW + ' MW' : 'Capacity not disclosed') + '</span>';
      el.appendChild(label);

      el.addEventListener("click", function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); selectSite(site.id); });
      el.addEventListener("keydown", function(e){ if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") { e.preventDefault(); selectSite(site.id); } });

      new maplibregl.Marker({ element: el, anchor: "center" }).setLngLat([site.lon, site.lat]).addTo(map);
      pinEls[site.id] = el;
    });

    document.getElementById("mapLoading").style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("mapCaption").style.display = "block";
    document.getElementById("mapCount").textContent = SITES.length + " sites plotted";
  }

  map.on("load", function(){
    buildPins();
  });
  map.on("error", function(e){
    document.getElementById("mapLoading").textContent = "Couldn't load the map — check your connection and reload.";
  });

  // Scrolling/pinching out closes the detail card — treat it as the user
  // backing out to look at the wider map again. Only reacts to genuine
  // user gestures (e.getOriginalEvent() is set for wheel/touch/drag input,
  // unset for our own flyTo/fitBounds calls) so selecting a site or
  // hitting "reset view" doesn't self-close the card it just opened.
  var lastZoom = map.getZoom();
  map.on("zoom", function(e){
    var z = map.getZoom();
    if (e.originalEvent && z < lastZoom && detailPanel.classList.contains("open")) {
      closeDetailPanel();
    }
    lastZoom = z;
  });

  function zoomToSite(site, targetZoom){
    map.flyTo({ center: [site.lon, site.lat], zoom: targetZoom || DEFAULT_SITE_ZOOM, duration: 650 });
  }

  document.getElementById("resetView").addEventListener("click", function(){
    map.fitBounds(fitBoundsArg, { padding: 60, duration: 500 });
  });

  // ---- Provider dashboard (one card per provider found in the data) -----
  var providers = Object.keys(providerColor);
  var activeProviders = {};
  providers.forEach(function(p){ activeProviders[p] = true; });

  function providerStats(p){
    var sites = SITES.filter(function(s){ return s.provider === p; });
    var operational = sites.filter(function(s){ return s.status === "Operational"; });
    var disclosed = operational.filter(function(s){ return s.capacityMW != null; });
    var totalGW = disclosed.reduce(function(sum, s){ return sum + s.capacityMW; }, 0) / 1000;
    return { siteCount: sites.length, operationalCount: operational.length, totalGW: totalGW, disclosedCount: disclosed.length };
  }

  var dashboardEl = document.getElementById("providerDashboard");
  var providerCardEls = {};
  providers.forEach(function(p){
    var stats = providerStats(p);
    var capacityLabel, capacitySub;
    if (stats.operationalCount === 0) {
      capacityLabel = "—";
      capacitySub = "no operational sites yet";
    } else if (stats.disclosedCount === 0) {
      capacityLabel = "—";
      capacitySub = "operational capacity undisclosed";
    } else {
      capacityLabel = stats.totalGW.toFixed(2);
      capacitySub = stats.disclosedCount < stats.operationalCount
        ? "GW (" + stats.disclosedCount + "/" + stats.operationalCount + " operational disclosed)"
        : "GW operational";
    }

    var card = document.createElement("div");
    card.className = "provider-card";
    card.style.setProperty("--dot", colorFor(p));
    card.innerHTML =
      '<div class="provider-card-head">' +
        '<span class="provider-card-dot"></span>' +
        '<span class="provider-card-name">' + p + '</span>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="provider-card-stats">' +
        '<div><div class="provider-stat-value">' + capacityLabel + '</div><div class="provider-stat-label">' + capacitySub + '</div></div>' +
        '<div><div class="provider-stat-value">' + stats.siteCount + '</div><div class="provider-stat-label">site' + (stats.siteCount === 1 ? '' : 's') + '</div></div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="provider-newsfeed">Newsfeed coming soon.</div>';

    card.addEventListener("click", function(){ expandProvider(p); });
    providerCardEls[p] = card;

    var toggle = document.createElement("button");
    toggle.className = "provider-toggle";
    toggle.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "true");
    toggle.title = "Toggle " + p + " on map";
    toggle.addEventListener("click", function(e){
      e.stopPropagation();
      activeProviders[p] = !activeProviders[p];
      toggle.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(activeProviders[p]));
      card.classList.toggle("inactive", !activeProviders[p]);
      renderTable();
      SITES.forEach(function(s){
        if (pinEls[s.id]) pinEls[s.id].classList.toggle("dim", !activeProviders[s.provider]);
      });
    });
    card.appendChild(toggle);

    dashboardEl.appendChild(card);
  });

  // ---- Table ------------------------------------------------------------
  var tbody = document.getElementById("tableBody");
  var rowEls = {};

  // Status column filter — defaults to "operational only" since that's
  // almost always what's actually relevant; "All" brings back
  // planned/under-construction rows too.
  var statusFilter = "operational";
  var statusToggle = document.getElementById("statusToggle");
  function updateStatusToggle(){
    if (statusFilter === "operational") {
      statusToggle.className = "status-toggle status-pill status-operational";
      statusToggle.textContent = "Operational";
      statusToggle.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "true");
      statusToggle.title = "Showing operational sites only — click to show all statuses";
    } else {
      statusToggle.className = "status-toggle status-pill status-all";
      statusToggle.textContent = "All";
      statusToggle.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "false");
      statusToggle.title = "Showing all statuses — click to show operational only";
    }
  }
  statusToggle.addEventListener("click", function(){
    statusFilter = statusFilter === "operational" ? "all" : "operational";
    updateStatusToggle();
    renderTable();
  });
  updateStatusToggle();

  function renderTable(){
    tbody.innerHTML = "";
    rowEls = {};
    var shown = 0;
    var sorted = SITES.slice().sort(tableSortCompare);
    sorted.forEach(function(site){
      if (!activeProviders[site.provider]) return;
      if (statusFilter === "operational" && site.status !== "Operational") return;
      shown++;
      var tr = document.createElement("tr");
      tr.setAttribute("data-id", site.id);
      tr.innerHTML =
        '<td><span class="provider-dot" style="background:' + colorFor(site.provider) + '"></span>' + site.provider + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + (site.site || '—') + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + site.city + ', ' + site.country + '</td>' +
        '<td><span class="status-pill status-' + statusSlug(site.status) + '">' + site.status + '</span></td>' +
        '<td class="mono">' + (site.capacityMW != null ? site.capacityMW + ' MW' : 'Not disclosed') + '</td>';
      tr.addEventListener("click", function(){ selectSite(site.id); });
      tbody.appendChild(tr);
      rowEls[site.id] = tr;
    });
    document.getElementById("count").innerHTML = "<b>" + shown + "</b> / " + SITES.length + " sites shown";
  }
  renderTable();

  // ---- Selection ----------------------------------------------------------
  var currentId = null;
  var detailPanel = document.getElementById("detailPanel");
  var detailPanelBody = document.getElementById("detailPanelBody");

  function goToSiteOnMap(id){
    switchToMapTab();
    selectSite(id);
  }

  function closeDetailPanel(){
    currentId = null;
    detailPanel.classList.remove("open");
    Object.keys(pinEls).forEach(function(k){ pinEls[k].classList.remove("active"); });
    Object.keys(rowEls).forEach(function(k){ rowEls[k].classList.remove("active"); });
  }
  document.getElementById("detailClose").addEventListener("click", closeDetailPanel);

  function selectSite(id){
    currentId = id;
    var site = SITES.filter(function(s){ return s.id === id; })[0];
    if (!site) return;

    Object.keys(pinEls).forEach(function(k){ pinEls[k].classList.toggle("active", k === id); });
    Object.keys(rowEls).forEach(function(k){ rowEls[k].classList.toggle("active", k === id); });
    zoomToSite(site);
    detailPanel.classList.add("open");

    var color = colorFor(site.provider);
    var sourcesHtml = (site.sources || []).map(function(s){
      return '<a href="' + s.url + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">' + s.label + '</a>';
    }).join(', ');

    detailPanelBody.innerHTML =
      '<div class="detail-head">' +
        '<div><h2>' + site.city + '</h2><p class="region-code">' + (site.site || site.country) + '</p></div>' +
        '<span class="provider-tag" style="background:' + color + '">' + site.provider + '</span>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<dl class="kv">' +
        '<dt>Country</dt><dd>' + site.country + '</dd>' +
        '<dt>Coordinates</dt><dd>' + site.lat.toFixed(4) + ', ' + site.lon.toFixed(4) + '</dd>' +
        '<dt>Status</dt><dd><span class="status-pill status-' + statusSlug(site.status) + '">' + site.status + '</span></dd>' +
        '<dt>Capacity</dt><dd>' + (site.capacityMW != null ? site.capacityMW + ' MW' : 'Not disclosed') + '</dd>' +
      '</dl>' +
      '<div class="notes-box">' + (site.notes && site.notes.length ? site.notes : "No notes yet — add one in data/sites.js.") + '</div>' +
      '<p class="source-line">Updated ' + (site.lastUpdated || '—') + (sourcesHtml ? ' · Source: ' + sourcesHtml : '') + '</p>';
  }

  // ---- Sources tab --------------------------------------------------------
  function renderSourcesTab(){
    var body = document.getElementById("sourcesBody");
    body.innerHTML = "";
    SITES.forEach(function(site){
      var tr = document.createElement("tr");
      var links = (site.sources || []).map(function(s){
        return '<a href="' + s.url + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">' + s.label + '</a>';
      }).join('<br>');
      tr.innerHTML =
        '<td><span class="provider-dot" style="background:' + colorFor(site.provider) + '"></span>' +
          site.provider + ' — ' + site.city + (site.site ? ' <span class="region-code">(' + site.site + ')</span>' : '') + '</td>' +
        '<td class="mono">' + (site.lastUpdated || '—') + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + (links || '<span class="detail-empty" style="margin:0">No sources logged</span>') + '</td>';
      body.appendChild(tr);
    });
  }
  renderSourcesTab();

  // ---- Provider page (opened by clicking a dashboard card) --------------
  var providerTabPanel = document.getElementById("providerTabPanel");
  var providerPageDot = document.getElementById("providerPageDot");
  var providerPageName = document.getElementById("providerPageName");
  var providerPageStats = document.getElementById("providerPageStats");
  var providerPageLocations = document.getElementById("providerPageLocations");
  var providerPagePartners = document.getElementById("providerPagePartners");
  var providerPageHeadlines = document.getElementById("providerPageHeadlines");
  var providerPageSearchLink = document.getElementById("providerPageSearchLink");

  function renderProviderPage(p){
    var stats = providerStats(p);
    providerPageDot.style.setProperty("--dot", colorFor(p));
    providerPageName.textContent = p;

    var capacityLabel, capacitySub;
    if (stats.operationalCount === 0) {
      capacityLabel = "—"; capacitySub = "no operational sites yet";
    } else if (stats.disclosedCount === 0) {
      capacityLabel = "—"; capacitySub = "operational capacity undisclosed";
    } else {
      capacityLabel = stats.totalGW.toFixed(2);
      capacitySub = stats.disclosedCount < stats.operationalCount
        ? "GW (" + stats.disclosedCount + "/" + stats.operationalCount + " operational disclosed)"
        : "GW operational";
    }
    providerPageStats.innerHTML =
      '<div><div class="provider-page-stat-value">' + capacityLabel + '</div><div class="provider-page-stat-label">' + capacitySub + '</div></div>' +
      '<div><div class="provider-page-stat-value">' + stats.siteCount + '</div><div class="provider-page-stat-label">total site' + (stats.siteCount === 1 ? '' : 's') + '</div></div>' +
      '<div><div class="provider-page-stat-value">' + stats.operationalCount + '</div><div class="provider-page-stat-label">operational</div></div>';

    var providerSites = SITES.filter(function(s){ return s.provider === p; }).sort(tableSortCompare);
    providerPageLocations.innerHTML = providerSites.map(function(s){
      return '<li class="provider-site-item" data-id="' + s.id + '">' +
        '<span class="status-dot status-' + statusSlug(s.status) + '"></span>' +
        '<span class="provider-site-name">' + (s.site || s.city) + '</span>' +
        '<span class="provider-site-loc">' + s.city + ', ' + s.country + '</span>' +
        '<span class="provider-site-cap">' + (s.capacityMW != null ? s.capacityMW + ' MW' : '—') + '</span>' +
      '</li>';
    }).join('');
    providerPageLocations.querySelectorAll(".provider-site-item").forEach(function(li){
      li.addEventListener("click", function(){
        goToSiteOnMap(li.getAttribute("data-id"));
        scrollToMap();
      });
    });

    // Partnerships (data/providers.js) — major labs/companies with a
    // disclosed relationship to this provider, distinct from the site-level
    // sources and the dated headline feed.
    var partners = (providerLookup[p] && providerLookup[p].partners) || [];
    providerPagePartners.innerHTML = partners.length
      ? partners.map(function(partner){
          var sourceLinks = (partner.sources || []).map(function(s){
            return '<a href="' + s.url + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">' + s.label + '</a>';
          }).join(', ');
          return '<li class="partner-card">' +
            '<div class="partner-top">' +
              '<span class="partner-name">' + partner.name + '</span>' +
              '<span class="partner-relationship">' + partner.relationship + '</span>' +
            '</div>' +
            (partner.detail ? '<p class="partner-detail">' + partner.detail + '</p>' : '') +
            (sourceLinks ? '<span class="partner-meta">' + (partner.since ? partner.since + ' · ' : '') + sourceLinks + '</span>' : '') +
          '</li>';
        }).join('')
      : '<li class="partners-empty">No disclosed partnerships logged yet — see data/providers.js.</li>';

    // Curated company-level headlines (data/news.js, via news-agent) take
    // priority when available. Falls back to citations already attached to
    // this provider's sites (data/sites.js) when there's no curated list
    // yet — that fallback is fact-sourcing, not real news, but beats
    // showing nothing.
    var curated = (typeof NEWS !== "undefined" && NEWS[p]) ? NEWS[p] : [];

    if (curated.length) {
      providerPageHeadlines.innerHTML = curated.slice().sort(function(a, b){
        return (b.date || "").localeCompare(a.date || "");
      }).map(function(h){
        var sourceLinks = (h.sources || []).map(function(s){
          return '<a href="' + s.url + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">' + s.label + '</a>';
        }).join(', ');
        return '<li class="headline-item">' +
          '<div class="headline-top">' +
            '<span class="headline-date">' + (h.date || '') + '</span>' +
            '<span class="headline-category">' + (h.category || 'other') + '</span>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<span class="headline-title">' + h.headline + '</span>' +
          (h.why ? '<p class="headline-why">' + h.why + '</p>' : '') +
          (sourceLinks ? '<span class="headline-meta">Source: ' + sourceLinks + '</span>' : '') +
        '</li>';
      }).join('');
    } else {
      var seenUrls = {};
      var fallbackHeadlines = [];
      providerSites
        .slice()
        .sort(function(a, b){ return (b.lastUpdated || "").localeCompare(a.lastUpdated || ""); })
        .forEach(function(s){
          (s.sources || []).forEach(function(src){
            if (seenUrls[src.url]) return;
            seenUrls[src.url] = true;
            fallbackHeadlines.push({ label: src.label, url: src.url, site: s.site || s.city, lastUpdated: s.lastUpdated });
          });
        });

      providerPageHeadlines.innerHTML = fallbackHeadlines.length
        ? '<li class="headline-empty">No curated headlines yet — showing sourced citations from this provider\'s sites instead.</li>' +
          fallbackHeadlines.map(function(h){
            return '<li class="headline-item">' +
              '<a href="' + h.url + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">' + h.label + '</a>' +
              '<span class="headline-meta">' + h.site + (h.lastUpdated ? ' · checked ' + h.lastUpdated : '') + '</span>' +
            '</li>';
          }).join('')
        : '<li class="headline-empty">No sourced coverage logged yet — see data/sites.js.</li>';
    }

    providerPageSearchLink.href = "https://www.google.com/search?tbm=nws&q=" + encodeURIComponent(p + " data center");
    providerPageSearchLink.textContent = "Search for more coverage of " + p + " →";
  }

  // Expanding a provider replaces the site table (not the map/detail-card
  // area above) with that provider's full panel, and collapses every
  // dashboard card down to just its heading — an inline accordion, not a
  // separate page/route. Clicking the same provider's (now-collapsed)
  // heading again, or the back link, returns to the normal view.
  var tableSection = document.getElementById("tableSection");
  var mapPanelEl = document.querySelector(".map-panel");
  var expandedProvider = null;

  function scrollToMap(){
    if (mapPanelEl) mapPanelEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
  }

  // MapLibre v5 auto-observes container resizes, but firing an explicit
  // resize right as the CSS transition finishes avoids any lag/blank-tile
  // flash while it catches up on its own.
  mapPanelEl.addEventListener("transitionend", function(e){
    if (e.propertyName === "min-height") map.resize();
  });

  function expandProvider(p){
    if (expandedProvider === p) { collapseProviderPanel(); return; }
    expandedProvider = p;
    renderProviderPage(p);
    Object.keys(providerCardEls).forEach(function(name){
      providerCardEls[name].classList.add("collapsed");
      providerCardEls[name].classList.toggle("active", name === p);
    });
    tableSection.hidden = true;
    providerTabPanel.hidden = false;
    mapPanelEl.classList.add("compact");
  }

  function collapseProviderPanel(){
    expandedProvider = null;
    mapPanelEl.classList.remove("compact");
    Object.keys(providerCardEls).forEach(function(name){
      providerCardEls[name].classList.remove("collapsed", "active");
    });
    providerTabPanel.hidden = true;
    tableSection.hidden = false;
  }

  document.getElementById("providerBack").addEventListener("click", collapseProviderPanel);

  // ---- Tabs ---------------------------------------------------------------
  var tabBtnMap = document.getElementById("tabBtnMap");
  var tabBtnSources = document.getElementById("tabBtnSources");
  var mapTabPanel = document.getElementById("mapTabPanel");
  var sourcesTabPanel = document.getElementById("sourcesTabPanel");

  function switchToMapTab(){
    tabBtnMap.classList.add("active"); tabBtnMap.setAttribute("aria-selected","true");
    tabBtnSources.classList.remove("active"); tabBtnSources.setAttribute("aria-selected","false");
    mapTabPanel.hidden = false; sourcesTabPanel.hidden = true;
  }
  function switchToSourcesTab(){
    tabBtnSources.classList.add("active"); tabBtnSources.setAttribute("aria-selected","true");
    tabBtnMap.classList.remove("active"); tabBtnMap.setAttribute("aria-selected","false");
    sourcesTabPanel.hidden = false; mapTabPanel.hidden = true;
  }
  tabBtnMap.addEventListener("click", switchToMapTab);
  tabBtnSources.addEventListener("click", switchToSourcesTab);

})();
</script>
